observations.name: Default model reads/serialization hide sensitive fields
observations.expected: Defense in depth: default model read and JSON omit device tokens and OTP hashes
observations.review: Default User JSON/lean includes fcmTokens and OTP JSON includes otpHash; explicit public/populated route projections exclude credentials.
observations.impactLimit: Defense in depth for future serialization mistakes; no current credential disclosure.

observations.name: Pending request pair duplicates are constrained at data layer
observations.expected: Defense in depth: duplicate active request pair cannot persist

actual.scope: direct model concurrency; HTTP race not claimed

observations.review: Pair indexes are nonunique and controller checks then creates. Two overlapping direct model inserts persist duplicate pending records.
observations.impactLimit: Data consistency hardening, not a newly demonstrated HTTP exploit.

observations.name: Expired notification excluded before asynchronous TTL cleanup
observations.expected: Policy candidate: expired inbox item is not served or counted while awaiting TTL deletion
observations.review: The TTL index exists, but inbox/count queries do not filter expiresAt. With only disposable TTL sweeping paused, an already-expired record is returned200/count1.

observations.name: Editing a deleted message cannot restore stored text
observations.expected: Deleted message update is denied and placeholder content remains unchanged
observations.review: editMessage has no isDeleted guard. The model blanks content only when isDeleted changes; a later edit saves new text while the deleted flag/date remain unchanged.
observations.impactLimit: Own live edit200 and deletion200 controls precede a deleted edit200 that restores stored synthetic text. No cross-user read or old-media resurrection is claimed.

observations.name: Deletion removes denormalized quote and channel text copies
observations.expected: Policy candidate: delete scrubs copied previews as well as original content

actual.sourceIntent: quote snapshot preservation is explicit; retention policy unresolved

observations.review: Original text is blanked but quote/sidebar copies persist. Quote retention is explicitly intentional in schema comments.
observations.impactLimit: Clinical text retention policy; no new cross-user read claimed.

observations.name: Inactive space blocks protected channel read
observations.expected: Policy candidate: inactive space membership cannot authorize channel data

actual.deactivationOrigin: model-seeded; no space deactivation endpoint exists

observations.review: Discovery filters isActive, while channel access checks membership without space active state. A model-seeded inactive space still returns message data200.
observations.impactLimit: Lifecycle policy; severity depends on deactivation semantics.

observations.name: Missing resource references are rejected at model boundary
observations.expected: Defense in depth: required ObjectId refs must point to existing related resources

actual.scope: model writes only; refs are not foreign keys

observations.review: Mongoose ObjectId refs allow missing related documents; direct model probes persist orphan associations.
observations.impactLimit: Persistence defense in depth; no new controller authorization failure.

observations.name: Device token cannot remain bound to two accounts
observations.expected: Policy candidate: device token registration has a defined account-transfer boundary

actual.scope: model sequential registration; provider delivery not executed

observations.review: Sequential synthetic registrations persist the same device token on two users; per-user dedup/cap controls pass and there is no global ownership contract.
observations.impactLimit: Policy-dependent cross-account notification/privacy risk; live delivery is unverified.

observations.name: Socket availability write enforces schema note limit
observations.expected: Socket update rejects oversized note without persisting invalid availability

actual.transport: direct real handler with synthetic socket; MongoDB is real

observations.review: findByIdAndUpdate omits runValidators and handler note-length checks;101 characters persist despite schema maxlength100.
